# Logsteps: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code dcd0a4b99b03 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Walk a room with your phone and get a 3D model you can replay, measure, pin notes on, share with a link and edit on your computer.
**Live:** https://logsteps.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/logsteps · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/logsteps/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py logsteps` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Native Forms since 2026-11-08 (branch `forms`).** Pages, menus, lists and dialogs are Forms; the 3D and camera work
  stays JavaScript: `theme/assets/ls-viewer.js` (three.js viewer, LS.open/LS.controls, moved unchanged from the old
  _viewer.html), `ls-cards.js` (LS.roomArt drawing, LS.ROOMS), `ls-screens.js` (the Capture and Studio editors, moved
  unchanged), `ls-kit.js` (the old window.UI helpers the engines need: UI.api through `window.LS_BRIDGE` = ls.py
  `_bridge`, toasts/yes-no through `LS.host`, UI.page/UI.mountScreen, and `LS.mountView` for Components/Viewer).
- **Two ways an engine sits in a page:** `Components/Viewer` (scan + share pages: the room view + control bar; events
  `ready`, `picked`; pick() makes the next tap a pin) and `Components/Screen` (Capture, Studio: the whole editor is one
  engine screen; pages set `waits = True` and the screen sets UI_READY itself). router.show() calls `leave()` on the
  old page (timers, 3D views).
- The scan page's polling and Home's polling are Anvil Timers (4 s / 5 s), quiet calls (`call_s`).
- Card picture: the Scan page sends `set_thumb` from the viewer's snapshot the first time the owner opens a ready room.
- `tools/make_demo_scans.py` writes theme/assets/demo-*.ply + server_code/DemoScenes.py. The old make_demo_thumbs.py
  (needed the old dev server) was not carried over: the demo JPGs in theme/assets stay as they are.
- Server tests: tools/testing/test_server.py reads the schema from anvil.yaml (no sync_to_anvil.py any more); the mock's
  server.py keeps `run_endpoint` for the scan-station HTTP tests.
- app.css was composed from the old core.css + page styles (scratch compose script): Labels render
  `<div><i></i><span>`, so selectors never target bare `i`/`span` inside places holding Labels (`.lb-dot`, `.tick`).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_demo_scans.py`: Make the demo scans: procedural rooms sampled like a real scan (noise, speckles, light from the win…
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
